messages.content: The contract requires: interior end moved backward (not rejection), and only reject a nonempty read that cannot progress. The current subject.mjs rejects instead of moving `end` back. Fixing that while preserving everything else:
messages.reasoning_content:
The contract requires: interior end should move backward, and reject nonempty read that cannot make progress. Current subject.mjs doesn't move end back. Also max_chars default 1024? Contract doesn't specify default. Keep API: preserve return fields, don't mutate inputs.

Write replacement: end = min(text.length, offset+max_chars); while(splitPair(end)) end--; then if(end===offset && offset<text.length) throw 'inspection-range-splits-unicode'.

Keep code errors as-is; use same need codes.
